items.title: Identity Resolution
items.summary: Consumers appear across 100+ DAS systems with inconsistent identifiers. The same person is in the CRM as "John Smith" with one email, in the DMS as "J. Smith" with a different phone number, and in a Meta ad as a hashed email. The CDP needs to recognize all three as one golden record.
